To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the SE alleles and the SE-DQ3, 4, 5 haplotypes are associated with anti-CCPP positive and anti-CCPP negative RA in Han Chinese.
HLA-DR4-DQ3/5 haplotype is strongly associated with both anti-citrullinated protein/peptide antibody (ACPA)–positive and ACPA–negative RA in Han population.

the SE alleles and its DR-DQ hapotypes are highly associated with RA in Han Chinese population, and the SE-DQ3/DQ4/DQ5 haplotypes are associated with both anti CCP-positive and -negative RA, and the SE-DRB1*04:05 allele was the strongest RA risk allele.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the association between HLA-DR-DQ haplotyping and RA in Chinese Han population.
the association of HLAB-DRB1 SE alleles and its DR-DQ haplo-types with RA susceptibility in the Han population.
the association of DR-DQ hapotypes with RA in Han population.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the HLA-DR-DQ haplotypes, especially SE-DQ3, SE-DQ4, and SE-DQ5, are associated with RA susceptibility, while the HLA- DR-DQ haplots SE-DQ1, SE-DQ2, SE-DQ6, SE-DQ7, and SE-DQA1 are protective against RA.
the SE alleles and its associated DR-DQ haplots SE-DQ3, SE-DQ4 and SE-DQ5 were highly associated both anti-CCPs positive and negative RA susceptibility.

SE-dependent DR-DQB1 alleles, haplotypes and DR-DQ3/DRB1 SE/DRB1 non-SE/DRB1 DRRA haplotypes were strongly associated with RA susceptibility, whereas the DRB1 DRRE/DRB1DRRA/DRB1SE/DRB5/6/7 haplotype showed protective effects in Chinese Han.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SE alleles and SE-dependent DR-DQB1 haplotypes were the main genetic risk factors for RA in Chinese Han population.
SE-DQ3 haplotype was the most significant RA-associated haplotype.
SE alleles and haplotypes were strongly associated with RA in Han Chinese.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the SE-DQ3 haplotype is a major susceptibility haplotype for RA in Han population.
the HLA class II genes and haplotypes are associated with RA susceptibility and the association is not affected by the anti-CCP antibody.
HLA DR-DQ haplo-type is an important genetic factor in the pathogenesis of RA.
